name: Gothic II: Piratenleben
storyline: This mod tells the story of a young man named Rhen, a citizen of Khorinis who works at the Red Lantern but is fed up with poverty and hunger. His dream is to join the pirates. One day, he receives a teleportation scroll from an alchemist, which transports him to the faction's camp under the leadership of Captain Greg. After hard and at times very dangerous work, Rhen fulfills his dream and becomes a pirate.
summary: In this mod, you control the fate of Rhen, a young lad from the port city of Khorinis, who wants to join the pirates to escape poverty and hopelessness from previous life. You can expect 3 chapters packed with interesting, innovative quests that take place in familiar but sometimes significantly altered areas of the Gothic 2 worlds and dungeons. Other features include a variety of familiar and new NPCs, an adjustable difficulty level, monster respawn based on the player level, and full voice acting (optional). A true highlight is the witty dialogue, which includes numerous jabs at a well-known, unnamed hero. Pirate Life (original title - Piratenleben) will transport you to the rough world of adventurous pirates for 15 to 20 hours across Jharkendar.
